lastCompletedLayerName: Security and isolation overhead without reducing protection
reason: Integrated SecurityProfile into UX-ROM as a protection-preserving Layer 7 assessment. The bounded profile records selected Defender, active firewall, and Device Guard state, then measures a fixed Microsoft security-process catalog with warmed CPU, I/O, and private-working-set counters plus observer calibration. The ten-second lab run retained five samples for MsMpEng and NisSrv; Defender real-time and tamper protection remained enabled, all three firewall profiles were enabled, VBS reported running, and observer median/p95 were 145.987/170.996 ms with an estimated 8.548% duty cycle. The full relevant suite passed 129 tests. No protection or Windows state changed and no performance-gain claim was made.
